Subject: User Data Processing Consent (Version v2.3.1) – Document ID 3f8e1a2b-7c4d-4f9a-9b6e-1d2c3f4b5a6d  

This consent document outlines the terms under which user data may be collected, processed, stored, and shared for analytics and service improvement purposes. The user agrees to allow the organization to use anonymized data for research and marketing, while retaining the right to withdraw consent at any time through the provided user portal.
